title: Trace line
description: One line of a product's trace: where each output item came from, so feedback can be walked back to the step where it went wrong. JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, stored at <product>/.po/trace.jsonl. Three events: write (an agent wrote or rewrote an item; rev goes up by one each time), review (a reviewer looked at the items in a file) and remove (an item was taken out; its ID is never reused). The current state of an item is its latest write or remove line. Producers declare each write line as they write the item (skill trace-records); scripts/traces.py add fills in ts and rev and checks the line before appending it. scripts/traces.py check validates a whole product.

item_id.description: Stable item ID: the item type's three-letter prefix (x-item-types), a hyphen and a number of at least three digits, for example ACT-007. Numbered per product and prefix, in order, from 001. Never changed and never reused, even after the item is removed.

run.description: Run ID, run-<UTC yyyymmddhhmmss>-<4 hex>. A run is one pass of a stage, from the producer's brief to the gate, or one /po-rerun-from. po makes it with scripts/traces.py new-run and puts it in every brief.

agent.description: The agent's name as in agents/, for example actors-producer, or po for the coordinator.

versions.description: Name to version. The version is the short git commit of the file's last change in aidev-po, with +dirty if it had uncommitted edits. scripts/traces.py versions prints them all.

evidence_tag.description: Stated: the user or a source document said it. Inferred: reasoned from stated items; the upstream items say from what. Assumed: nobody said it; proceeding as if true, with a register assumption. Simulated: from simulated users or personas; a hypothesis, never evidence. Validated: confirmed by a real person or real data, source recorded.

rev.description: 1 for the first write, one more for each rewrite.

step.description: The step of the agent that wrote the item: the number and short name of the step in the agent's or skill's Steps list, for example 2-actor-sweep.

file.description: Markdown file, relative to the product folder, where the item ID appears.

summary.description: The item in one line, as written at this rev.

upstream.description: Item IDs this item was derived from (PROV wasDerivedFrom), declared by the agent as it writes. Upstream and relied_on together must not both be empty.

relied_on.description: Register IDs of the user answers, decisions and assumptions this item rests on.

sources.description: Documents, notes, transcripts or URLs, with a line or section where possible, for example workshops/2026-12-01-notes.md#L12. Validated needs at least one.

skills.description: Skills the agent applied for this item, name to version.

templates.description: Templates the file was built from, path under templates/ to version. Empty object if none.

aidev_po.description: Short git commit of the aidev-po checkout during the run, with +dirty if it had uncommitted edits. Pins every agent, skill and template version.

rerun.description: Set when the write was made by /po-rerun-from.

model.description: Optional: the model that ran the agent.

agent.description: The reviewer: a stage reviewer, challenger or evidence-auditor.

item_ids.description: Every item in the file at the time of the review.

findings.description: Findings that name an item. Used to measure how much a reviewer caught before the user saw it.

rev.description: One more than the item's last write.
